text: Working with APIs is an important skill for modern developers. Most APIs receive HTTP requests and return data, often in JSON format. Before you can use an API, you usually need authentication, such as an API key or a token. Remember that APIs often have rate limits, so you cannot send too many requests in a short time. Good error handling is also essential: check status codes and read error messages carefully. By following these basic rules, you can build reliable applications that communicate smoothly with other services.
